com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api

Interface IAbstractComponentPortSelector

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IElementSelector
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    IComponentPortSelector, IOriginComponentPortSelector, ISourceComponentPortSelector, ITargetComponentPortSelector

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IAbstractComponentPortSelector
extends IElementSelector
    The IAbstractComponentPortSelector API defines predicates for component port selector APIs.

    Per default the predicates are combined via logical AND. To realize other combinations, use the 'or','not' and 'and' predicates.
